notes.title: Unsorted Horror - OST Physical Release
notes.notes:
The Unsorted Horror soundtracks by Jabbu are now available on CD, in collaboration with Turtle Pals Tapes. This release features The Other Side, Concrete Tremor, and the very first official release of the Tartarus Engine soundtrack.

Thank you for playing!
